content: The following are detailed descriptions of Cephalexin products, including their formulations, dosages, and packaging information, as provided by TEVA Pharmaceuticals USA: 1. Cephalexin Capsules USP, 250 mg National Drug Code (NDC): 0093-3145-01 Each capsule contains 250 mg of Cephalexin. This product is available in bottles containing 100 capsules. It is a prescription-only medication (Rx only). 2. Cephalexin Capsules USP, 500 mg National Drug Code (NDC): 0093-3147-01 Each capsule contains 500 mg of Cephalexin. This product is available in bottles containing 100 capsules. It is a prescription-only medication (Rx only). 3. Cephalexin for Oral Suspension USP, 125 mg per 5 mL National Drug Code (NDC): 0093-4175-73 When reconstituted according to the provided directions, each 5 mL of the suspension contains 125 mg of Cephalexin. The usual pediatric dose is 25 to 50 mg per kilogram of body weight per day, divided into four doses. For more severe infections, the dose may be doubled. This product is intended for oral use only and is supplied in a 100 mL bottle (when mixed). It is a prescription-only medication (Rx only). 4. Cephalexin for Oral Suspension USP, 250 mg per 5 mL National Drug Code (NDC): 0093-4177-73 When reconstituted according to the provided directions, each 5 mL of the suspension contains 250 mg of Cephalexin. The usual pediatric dose is 25 to 50 mg per kilogram of body weight per day, divided into four doses. For more severe infections, the dose may be doubled. This product is intended for oral use only and is supplied in a 100 mL bottle (when mixed). It is a prescription-only medication (Rx only). 5. Cephalexin Tablets USP, 250 mg National Drug Code (NDC): 0093-2238-01 Each tablet contains 250 mg of Cephalexin. This product is available in bottles containing 100 tablets. It is a prescription-only medication (Rx only). 6. Cephalexin Tablets USP, 500 mg National Drug Code (NDC): 0093-2240-01 Each tablet contains 500 mg of Cephalexin. This product is available in bottles containing 100 tablets. It is a prescription-only medication (Rx only). All products are manufactured and distributed by TEVA Pharmaceuticals USA, located in Sellersville, PA 18960.
